# Test fixtures

## astronaut_collins.jpg

A head-and-shoulders crop of NASA's portrait of astronaut Eileen Collins
(1998), the `astronaut` sample image distributed with scikit-image
(`skimage/data/astronaut.png`). A work of the United States government, it
is in the public domain.

Used by the face-tracking tests (D-193), which need a real face: they move it
across a frame to make a recording at test time. No video is committed.
